parameters.subject: Weekly check — Quick 30s: did you post last Monday?
parameters.html: Hi there, Quick question — did you post last Monday? Please open this short form and answer 2 quick Qs (30s): 👉 Fill weekly post-check form If you answer "Yes" you'll be asked for: • topic heading • whether you want headings for the generated content • whether you need emojis • any description you already have (paste it in) If you answer "No" we'll skip this week and try again next Sunday. Thanks — automated reminder from your n8n assistant.
